items.html: And the explanation of the word "Kista deChayuta," mentioned in the Zohar in several places, means the measure of life. The meaning: now ZA returned to be as at first, in his measure, for at the time of his emanation he had only six extremities alone, as above. And when he returns to his first measure, he has no strength to shine in the Nukva and bestow upon her, for then ZA has only six extremities alone. And the Nukva has in her no aspect of mochin nor any limb of the body, only a tenth part of the ten parts that she has in her Gadlut, as above.
